Messages.Author: Jean-Philippe
Messages.Body:
If a vamp inscribes a Rutor's Hand on another vamp does the latter vamp have
to take an action in order to get the Rutor's Hand or just go into
torpor/pay 3 blood ?

thanx in advance for help,

Jean-Philippe

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jean-Philippe wrote:
> If a vamp inscribes a Rutor's Hand on another vamp does the latter vamp have
> to take an action in order to get the Rutor's Hand or just go into
> torpor/pay 3 blood ?

The former. Action cards require actions to play.
If it was a strike card, the minion would have to use his strike to play
it. And so on.
